'''March 2001 Pastimes tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Pastimes on 4 March 2001. [[Al Schaefer]] won it. It is known from Edmund Gray's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1840">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-05-pastimes-3-4-01d1840/ pastimes-3-4-01], DeckTech (edmund "edmund" gray, 5 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-05-pastimes-3-4-01d1840/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 4 March 2001
* '''Site:''' Pastimes
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Al Schaefer]]
